scope: Code and summarized sensitivity report review; reviewer did not open test prediction arrays
checks: Groups retain all molecules and ten states; same group resamples pair both predictions.
SST is recomputed from resampled sums/counts; variable group sizes handled correctly.
Baseline aggregate delta is checked against previously frozen test result.
limitations: Input alignment relies on the preceding frozen test evaluation; no new model selection.
Connectivity groups are not scaffold groups.
Positive interval remains sensitivity on exposed historical test, not fresh generalization evidence.
